problems.problem: The declared 'one hard-edge darker teal depth band crossing behind the middle' never rendered: image 1 shows only a single wavy contour-field edge at roughly y 490-560 sitting behind the cap and shoulders, after which the card is one uniform mid-teal. The promised depth-band descent is missing, so the 'line-density descent narrative' reads as one decorative patch instead of a layered survey map.

The contour engraving stops dead at the bottle's shoulder line, leaving the entire lower two-thirds (including the whole type plaque) as unmodulated flat teal. Against references 3-4, whose backgrounds carry graded atmosphere or compositional graphics behind the subject, this lower field reads as an empty wall with a pasted cutout rather than a designed plaque.

Hierarchy inside the plaque is compressed: the DAVIDOFF brand line (size 30, bbox y 1080-1102) and the EAU DE TOILETTE line (size 30, bbox y 1270-1292) are identical in size and weight, so the stack reads logo-title-twin-small-lines; only the closing rule differentiates the footer. Measured gaps are also uneven (base 1030 to logo 50px, logo to title 50px, title to subtitle 39px, subtitle to rule ~40px), giving no clear primary/secondary step below the title.

Title 'Cool Water' measures 618px wide (bbox x 228-846) against the brief's 'name set wide and centred near band width'; at roughly 57% of canvas width it sits visibly narrower than the contour band above and leaves the plaque under-occupied versus the wide centred lockups in the references.

changes.value: Seamless flat matte card in deep petrol teal, thin pale ice-blue bathymetric contour lines engraved across the upper half like a sea-floor survey map, a second sparser set of contour rings continuing faintly behind the middle zone, one hard-edge darker teal depth band crossing horizontally behind the middle, lower third calming to a very subtle vertical deepening of the same teal, perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, no texture gradients beyond printed lines, no objects
